packageRules.description: Keep the `typescript` package on 6.x: typescript-eslint and SvelteKit's sync need the TS 6 JS API, which TS 7 does not ship. TS 7 is installed side by side as @typescript/native for svelte-check --tsgo. Lift once typescript-eslint supports TS 7 (typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940). Matches by dep name so the @typescript/native alias (package typescript@7) still updates.
